name: r-parallelplot
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = '0.4.0' %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-parallelplot
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/parallelPlot_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/parallelPlot/parallelPlot_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1ce71ae05505b23db134e718db9d014174fa8fe6034f7a4858c3eaffd98f9051

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-htmlwidgets
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-htmlwidgets

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('parallelPlot')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('parallelPlot')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://gitlab.com/drti/parallelplot
  license: MIT
  summary: Create a parallel coordinates plot, using `htmlwidgets` package and `d3.js`.
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT'
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - DerThorsten
